contradictions_preserved: Voice task delegation has a hard Bash deny, but non-Bash mutation capabilities remain governed by ambient Claude settings/plugin state not bound by claude_frage itself.

Repository hooks/hooks.json can declare PreToolUse(*) and Stop while a headless invocation may run under a different installed/global/plugin configuration; source presence alone does not prove those hooks fired.
The donor installer explicitly documents sessions without plugin hook wiring, so hook availability is an installation/runtime property rather than a repository-only property.
Realtime memory and research paths remain unevenly intent-gated as already captured by RealtimeToolAuthorityMatrix/v1.
counterhypotheses: The installed host may consistently load exactly the intended Frankenstein plugin and global settings for every delegated claude -p invocation; this would reduce practical risk but requires exact invocation/load receipts before runtime credit.

A strict explicit --settings pin may not be the only correct implementation if the runtime can attest the actual resolved settings/plugin/hook set after launch; the requirement is exact environment identity, not one particular CLI flag.
